description: This file defines a Playwright test component class for interacting with the notifications settings UI in the Mattermost application, including methods to expand sections, verify visibility, and interact with notification options.

classes.name: NotificationsSettings
classes.description: A class representing the notifications settings UI component for automated testing with Playwright.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if the notifications settings container is visible.

methods.name: expandSection
methods.description: Expands a specific section within the notifications settings, e.g., keywords with highlight.

methods.name: verifySectionIsExpanded
methods.description: Verifies that a specific section within the notifications settings is expanded and visible.

methods.name: getKeywordsInput
methods.description: Retrieves the input element for keywords, ensuring it is visible.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Clicks the save button within the notifications settings.

calls: this.container.getByText('Enter non case-sensitive keywords, press Tab or use commas to separate them:')
this.container.getByText('These keywords will be shown to you with a highlight when anyone sends a message that includes them.')
